resolution.note: verbatim codex-cli 0.167.0 captures in test/fixtures/eval/codex-0.167.0 (provenance.json: command, version, exit, sha256): turn.failed has no usage, so only a lone turn.completed (thread total) is accountable; an ignored setting is an item.completed error item and now rejects the config; a non-zero exit without a turn (mask exit 70, Codex startup failure) is harness_error; retry error events no longer fail a recovered session

title: Verify eval session accounting against real Codex captures
body:
Lead override on PR #125 (`.krn/runs/claude/eval-arm/deliver/override-beafe1f.md`) left three eval session semantics unverified against the real Codex receiver: (1) whether `turn.failed` usage belongs in the run's token summary or only `turn.completed` (the lens said completed only; the code sums terminal turns); (2) how Codex reports an ignored or unrecognised config setting in `--json` mode (the detected message shapes in `test/evals/session.test.ts` are not from a capture); (3) a mask exit 70 without agent events is classified `agent_error` instead of `harness_error`. Capture each case verbatim from the real Codex binary pinned for FR-40, commit the captures as fixtures with their provenance, and make `src/evals/usage.ts` and `src/evals/session.ts` match them.
Acceptance: three verbatim captures with command, Codex version and sha256; tests built on them pass; the FR-40 run cannot start before this closes.
